typography.rules: Use Playfair Display for all numerical data (points, balances) to evoke an old-money luxury feel. Use Outfit for modern, clean secondary headings. Manrope for highly legible body text.

gold_shimmer_sweep.description: A subtle animated gradient that sweeps across premium cards to simulate light catching metallic gold.
gold_shimmer_sweep.css_classes: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-translate-x-full before:animate-[shimmer_2.5s_infinite] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-white/50 before:to-transparent

premium_card_effect.description: White cards with an extremely subtle gold-tinted border and a tinted shadow to feel like a premium physical invitation.
premium_card_effect.css_classes: bg-white border border-[#C68939]/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(198,137,57,0.06)] rounded-2xl transition-all duration-500 hover:shadow-[0_12px_48px_rgba(198,137,57,0.12)] hover:-translate-y-1

elegant_dividers.description: Use gradient lines instead of solid borders for section dividers to feel like editorial flourishes.
elegant_dividers.css_classes: h-[1px] w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#C68939]/30 to-transparent

gradient_typography.description: For high-impact numbers like Points or Tier Status.

micro_interactions.description: Use framer-motion for smooth tap/hover scaling on interactive elements like quick action icons. Add a subtle gold halo on hover.

glassmorphism_nav.description: For sticky headers or bottom navigation to maintain the cream background context while floating.

home_page: Wrap the primary 'Points Card' in the `premium_card_effect` but apply the white marble texture from media_assets lightly mixed with the background.
Apply `gold_shimmer_sweep` across the points value container.
Quick action icons (Scan, Redeem) should be encased in soft rounded squares (bg-white/50) with 1px gold borders, utilizing `micro_interactions` scaling.
Animate the points counter on mount using a React counter hook/framer-motion (e.g., ticking up from 0 to 1,250).
Featured stores should use an editorial layout: image fills the card, with a gradient overlay (black/0 to black/40 at bottom), white serif text for the brand.
wallet_page: Tier progress bar should be uniquely styled: a track of `bg-[#FAF8F5] border border-[#C68939]/20` with a fill of `bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E8C28D] to-[#C68939]` and a slow, continuous pulse animation.
The 'Balance Card' should utilize the elegant wavy cream texture from media_assets, ensuring text contrast remains high.
Recent activity list items should be separated by `elegant_dividers`.
explore_stores_page: Category pills must look like high-end retail tags: pill shape, 1px gold-tinted border, pure white background, elegant sans-serif text (`Outfit`), subtle gold glow when active.
Store cards should be minimalist: borderless, pure white background, soft shadow. On hover, the image scales up slightly inside a hidden overflow container.
tier_journey_page: The 7-tier ladder must feel physical. Each tier card should represent its metal (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, etc.) using custom gradient borders and subtle metallic noise textures.
Current tier gets an expanded 'Active' state card with the `gold_shimmer_sweep`.
bottom_navigation: The center gold camera button must be elevated with `shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(198,137,57,0.4)]`. It should have a slow, breathing scale animation (`animate-pulse` mixed with scale).

images.description: White marble texture for the Home Points card background
Elegant abstract wavy cream texture for the Wallet Balance card
Luxury boutique image for 'Featured Stores' banner or hero carousel
Chic boutique image for Explore list fallback

implementation_rules: DO NOT change the overall light cream (#FAF8F5) body background.
DO NOT redesign structural page layouts. Only apply these specific styles, borders, shadows, and animations ON TOP of the existing elements.
Add 'shimmer' keyframes to tailwind config: { keyframes: { shimmer: { '100%': { transform: 'translateX(100%)' } } } }.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure #2E2219 text maintains strong contrast against #FAF8F5 and #FFFFFF. Use #C68939 exclusively for large decorative elements, borders, or text sizes >18px.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, and tier cards MUST have a `data-testid` attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., `data-testid='scan-bill-center-button'`).
